gate2.variant_perception: The market believes that the emergence of generative AI and conversational search will structurally impair the company's search monopoly and profitability due to higher inference costs and interface disruption [D05]. As the company optimizes its model architecture and monetizes AI-enhanced search, the competitive moat will prove more durable than current sentiment suggests [D01].

We expect a valuation re-rating from the current ~15.0x EV/EBIT toward 20.0x as the market gains confidence that the company can successfully integrate AI-driven search without structurally impairing long-term margins [D04], [Gate 2].

gate4.why_this_role_fits_the_era: Consistent with our 'Pershing Square 3.0' era focus on high-quality compounders, we view this as a mega-cap franchise where the market is temporarily mispricing intrinsic value due to fear of technological disruption; our role is to act as a long-term owner, allowing the compounding of earnings to drive returns rather than forcing external change [Gate 1], [Gate 3].

gate5.liquidity_assessment: The company maintains immense market capitalization and high daily trading volume, allowing a significant position to be built or exited within a quarter without undue market impact [D04].

final.memo:
The Company is a world-class, free-cash-flow-generative business that sits at the center of the global internet economy [D01]. It maintains a dominant search monopoly protected by massive scale and an unrivaled data advantage, generating over $60 billion in annual free cash flow [D01], [D02]. This is precisely the kind of simple, predictable, and durable compounder we seek to hold for the long term [Gate 4].

Market sentiment has turned negative due to fears that generative AI will structurally impair search monetization and increase inference costs [D05]. We believe the market is overreacting to short-term noise and temporary execution errors [D07]. The company’s historical ability to adapt its technology and integrate new interfaces into its existing, highly profitable ecosystem remains underestimated by current market participants [D01].

We have the opportunity to acquire this dominant franchise at an attractive ~15.0x EV/EBIT, a significant discount to our view of its long-term intrinsic value [D04]. With the company focusing on disciplined cost management—highlighted by its recent 12,000-person headcount reduction—and sustained share repurchases, we anticipate a path to mid-teens annual EPS growth and a valuation re-rating toward 20.0x as confidence in its AI monetization strategy increases [D03], [D04].

Our role is that of a long-term owner, supporting management as they refine the company’s cost structure and leverage its scale to optimize AI inference costs [D03], [Gate 2]. The balance sheet, featuring $99 billion in net cash, provides significant downside protection and optionality [D02]. We are initiating a 10% position, as we have high conviction that the company's competitive advantages are durable and its current market pricing presents an asymmetric opportunity for significant capital appreciation [Gate 5].
